notes.title: Bug fixing
notes.content:
Fixed Bugs:
[list]
[*] Fixed black UI background when using Native scaling
[*] Fixed a bug with placing items on trees
[*] Fixed missing localization in the "remove roof" message
[*] Fixed a bug with incorrect display of control key hints
[*] Fixed a bug where the UI appeared in save screenshot thumbnails
[*] Fixed a bug with the floor rotation button getting stuck
[*] Fixed issue where objects were no longer attached to floors after several saves
[*] Improved UI readability on bright objects
[*] Fixed lamp intensity reset when clicked multiple times
[*] Fixed frame rate limiter
[/list]

Features Added:
[list]
[*] Reworked the tutorial start screen
[*] Replaced text descriptions with control icons
[*] Object rotation is now retained when copying or moving items
[/list]
